title: Energy Vault acquires land for 125 MW Stoney Creek BESS in Australia after FIRB approval
summary: Energy Vault has acquired land for a 125 MW Battery Energy Storage System in New South Wales, marking a significant step towards sustainable energy solutions in Australia.
body_markdown:
# Energy Vault acquires land for 125 MW Stoney Creek BESS in Australia after FIRB approval


Energy Vault | 7 September 2026


**Energy Vault has completed the acquisition of land for its 125 MW, 1 GWh Stoney Creek Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) project in New South Wales, Australia.**
